# NM Ingenious

## About
NM Ingenious Management Services Pvt. Ltd. is an India-focused retail execution and workforce management company. The website describes its core proposition as turning shelf presence into sell-out through trained promoters, merchandising, BTL activations, retail intelligence, payroll and fractional HR services.

## Primary website
https://www.ingeniousmanagement.com/

## Key facts
- 18+ years of retail execution experience
- 2,150+ trained personnel
- 2,000+ MT & GT outlets
- Coverage across 31 states and union territories
- Office: Kandivali West, Mumbai
- Branches: Bengaluru and New Delhi

## Main services
1. Promoter Deployment and Management
2. Beauty Advisors and Product Counsellors
3. Merchandising and Visibility Execution
4. BTL Activations and Sampling
5. Real-Time Tracking and Reporting
6. Compliant Workforce Management
7. Payroll Services
8. Fractional HR Services

## Audience
The site positions its services for FMCG, beauty and personal care, health and wellness, food and beverage, premium brands, challenger brands, and D2C brands entering offline retail.

## Key concepts
- Sell-out acceleration
- Retail execution
- Last-three-feet conversion
- Promoter productivity
- Share of shelf and planogram compliance
- Store-level intelligence
- Reach and frequency
- Workforce compliance
- Third-party payroll
- Fractional HR
